label: thm:mass-energy-equivalence
title: Mass--energy equivalence ($E_{\mathfrak{H}} = \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{H}} \cdot c_q^2$)
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, \varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}) be an archimedean quantum observable universe with substrate parameter q and speed of light c_q = 1/(q-1) (speed of light). Let \mathfrak{H} be a knot composite in the Frobenius--Hopf object A. Then the crossing energy (crossing energy) and the categorical mass (mass identity) satisfy

  E_{\mathfrak{H}}
  =  \mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{H}} \cdot c_q^2
  =  \frac{\mathfrak{m}_{\mathfrak{H}}}{(q - 1)^2}.
heading: Theorem
